name: Landscape Album in Various Styles: Pleasure in a Mountain Brook
material: album leaf, ink and light color on paper
summary: Zha Shibiao, a native of Anhui province, moved to Yangzhou later in his career, like so many of his fellow countrymen. At age 68, he painted this album with seasonal landscapes in various styles. Painted in fresh colors and wet strokes, all depict typical scenes of Jiangnan, the Yangzi delta: a herd
